maya: quick question — trying to get the node SDK to hit our private VPC endpoint when behind corporate HTTP proxy. The weird bit: env var CUSTOM_BASE_URL=https://private.redwood.internal and HTTP_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:8080. SDK seems to prefer proxy and rewrites host header, breaking mTLS auth. Anyone seen this? Example repro: export CUSTOM_BASE_URL=...; export HTTP_PROXY=...; node example_stream.js and it 502s with TLS handshake error.
aj: I hit similar. My read of the code: explicit base_url in client options > CUSTOM_BASE_URL env > built-in default. But when HTTP_PROXY is set, the underlying http client uses CONNECT and behavior depends on the library — sometimes headers get rewritten. Can you paste the exact error/log snippet?
maya: paste error: ```Error: TLS handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
    at TLSSocket.onConnectEnd (node:internal/tls:###)
    at TLSSocket.emit (node:events:###)
``` Also we noticed the Authorization header disappears when requests go via our corp proxy (it looks like header filtering).
sam: corp proxies often strip auth headers or terminate TLS. For streaming/WS you want tunnel mode (CONNECT) and not TLS-terminating proxy. In node we solved it by either setting NO_PROXY for the private host or forcing the proxy agent to tunnel: e.g. use `agent: new HttpsProxyAgent({ host: 'corp-proxy', port: 8080, rejectUnauthorized: true, tunnel: true })`. Also watch SNI — proxy termination changes SNI and breaks client cert.
lina: quick doc note: SDK also exposes a command-line override `--base-url` which wins over env in most wrappers, but that won't help if the proxy terminates TLS. For private deployments that require client certs you must ensure the proxy supports CONNECT passthrough (no TLS MITM). If the proxy rewrites host header you can force `Host` via option `forceHostHeader: true` in low-level agent, but that is hacky.
maya: ok will try NO_PROXY first. quick follow up — for retries & streaming: should we configure retry logic on the SDK client or rely on platform-level retries? we saw duplicated messages when SDK retried stream connect.
aj: for streaming we only retry the connect, not message-level. SDK has `streamingRetry.backoff_ms` and `streamingRetry.max_attempts`. Duplicates usually come from server-side replays when connect succeeds but ACK was lost. Best practice: server includes monotonic message IDs and client dedupes on id. I'll paste a tiny snippet in the PR. Filed a small change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js/pull/512 — pinging @devex-bot for review. :eyes:
devex-bot: PR redwood-js#512 has been created by aj and assigned to maya. CI: unit tests passed, integration tests pending.
maya: thanks — I'll try NO_PROXY + tunnel settings today and report back. If that fixes it I'll add a short note to the devex SDK docs and a snippet in the node quickstart. Adding to sprint-12. :thumbsup:
